import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 as instructed
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_44/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_44/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_44/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_44/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Join all source tables on 'org_salary_period' (the primary key)
df01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='org_salary_period', how='inner', suffixes=('_0', '_1'))
df012 = pd.merge(df01, df2, on='org_salary_period', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_2'))
df_all = pd.merge(df012, df3, on='org_salary_period', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_3'))

# After join, aggregate counts of each attribute per org_salary_period
# The target schema columns are:
# ['org_salary_period': string, 'title': integer, 'company': integer, 'location': integer, 'summary': integer, 'salary': integer, 'href': integer, 'rate': integer, 'reviews': integer]

# Count non-null occurrences of each attribute across all sources per org_salary_period
# Since after join, columns are suffixed, count non-null values for each attribute across all suffixed columns

def count_non_null_across_sources(df, base_col):
    cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith(base_col)]
    return df[cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

result = pd.DataFrame()
result['org_salary_period'] = df_all['org_salary_period']

# Count title columns
title_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('title')]
result['title'] = df_all[title_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

company_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('company')]
result['company'] = df_all[company_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

location_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('location')]
result['location'] = df_all[location_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

summary_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('summary')]
result['summary'] = df_all[summary_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

salary_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('salary')]
result['salary'] = df_all[salary_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

href_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('href')]
result['href'] = df_all[href_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

rate_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('rate')]
result['rate'] = df_all[rate_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

reviews_cols = [c for c in df_all.columns if c.startswith('reviews')]
result['reviews'] = df_all[reviews_cols].notnull().sum(axis=1)

# Convert counts to int
for col in result.columns:
    if col != 'org_salary_period':
        result[col] = result[col].astype(int)

# Write output to target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_44/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
